walks.name: Pilgrimsleden Dalsland — day 1: Mellerud to Livarebosjön
walks.notes: The first day of a three-day hike from Mellerud to Edsleskog, ending with a hammock camp beside Livarebosjön.

walks.name: Pilgrimsleden Dalsland — day 2: Livarebosjön to Tansjön
walks.notes: The middle day of the Dalsland hike, continuing north from Livarebosjön to a second hammock camp beside Tansjön.

walks.name: Pilgrimsleden Dalsland — day 3: Tansjön to Edsleskog
walks.notes: The final morning of the Dalsland hike, from the Tansjön camp to the end of the Pilgrimsleden at Edsleskog.
